digest.component_or_area: documentation and public CLI guidance for file-impact declarations
propositions: The tri-state file-impact contract (undeclared, paths, none) was implemented but documented only incompletely across four reader-facing locations, leaving an authoritative author-facing contract gap.

The packaged public `rebar explain plan` CLI output and standalone docs (gate, ticket-model, event-schema) must communicate the complete tri-state semantics, replacement/clearing rules, roll-up behavior, and the advisory no-file-impact LLM criterion with separate why/where guidance.
A runtime public-behavior test must verify the CLI entry point communicates all tri-state, command, and advisory elements without coupling to prose layout, exact wording, or source inspection.

Semantic evidence checklist rows with path:line citations, reviewer identity, and commit SHA must independently verify standalone documentation criteria against the authoritative implementation at src/rebar/reducer/_processors.py:527-543.
File-impact changes (undeclared→paths, paths→none, none→undeclared) must clear replaced fields consistently and update the material fingerprint used by attestation.
Docs-only and test-only repository changes must declare paths (not none), and none reasons must separately explain why no repository file is touched and where output/evidence lives.
